text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Nakayama Festa, what do you think 
of her legs?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What do I think...? It's downright 
baffling, of course.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"I looked into her once when she became a 
topic of conversation, but no matter how 
much I dig, she doesn't come from a 
prestigious background like the other 
girls."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She's a truly ordinary Umamusume who came 
to the academy via standard racing lessons 
from an average household. And yet here 
she is, competing against El Condor 
Pasa...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"...It makes you wonder how exciting it'd 
be if they won. You really can't predict 
it at all."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayamaaa~ Lend me your legs for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Go borrow it from someone else~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, no no no! You can keep reading that, 
just stick it out right here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let me do this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done. Am I a nail genius or 
what?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I can't even move until this dries, 
damn it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me. I'll keep you company 
in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't the vibe this year feel totally 
different from last year's training camp?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Last year, that Oaks girl decided not to 
go to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. 
Everyone was so down about it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's restless right now, talking 
about the future Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... And of all people, Nakayama's 
right smack in the middle. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What are you laughing at?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm happy! Got a problem with 
that?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Beat El for real, and blow past everything 
they said was impossible. You can do it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you do that, it makes me feel 
like I won't lose to you either.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Do you really still intend to beat me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Obvi. So you'd better do your best, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, messin' around with someone 
else's nails like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You really are something else, you know 
that?
